# Debian packaging module notes

Scope: source metadata, split binary payloads, VDR ABI dependencies and isolated package builds.

- Preserve `plugin-only` behavior: no daemon, Backend Agent or web build/stage in that profile. Verify with `tools/test_packaging_profiles.py`.
- Ensure the SuiteBridge package has no daemon binary-package dependency. It **must** use the VDR ABI dependency generated by `dh_vdrplugin_depends`.
- Never copy runtime secrets, databases or persistent state into the package.
- Keep source and plugin builds under ordinary user privileges and only stage to explicitly scoped `DESTDIR`. Live installs and service restarts are out of scope for CI.
- Maintain `debian/rules` mode 100755; GitHub file-content updates may reset executable bits, so inspect git mode after modifications.
- Do not upload to Launchpad until clean distro build, package ownership, legal metadata and upgrade gates pass.
- Update packaging documentation and regression tests with each change.
